These '''freighters''' were operated by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], one of which acted as his personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. They were used for smuggling for Borvo's [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire]]. Borvo donated three to the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] to hold [[Liberation of enslavement camps|liberated]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] but betrayed the Security Forces. [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] tracked Borvo's transport to [[Porso Hill]] and destroyed it, forcing Borvo to flee.

==Characteristics==
The freighter was beige in color and had multiple mounted guns. The forward command section was capable of splitting off and acting as an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]].<ref name="BFN" />

==History==
[[File:BorvoFreighter-EscapePod_BFN.jpg|200px|left]]
Borvo had at least four of these freighters in his fleet, one of which acted his his personal transport. [[Pilot/Legends|Piloted]] by [[Adela Tyché]], Borvo used the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] for his [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] runs throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] when he was trying to establish his [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|criminal empire]]. Operating out of the northern [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] mountains during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Borvo and his ship came under fire from [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] forces. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] escorted the freighter to Borvo's base, and in return the Hutt provided valuable intelligence. Borvo sent three of his freighters to pickup rescued civilians. A ship of this type was later seen leaving a [[plasma mining camp]], which Sykes spotted and wondered whether or not it was Borvo's. Sykes later destroyed Borvo's transport and it's accompanying [[Borvo the Hutt's starfighter|starfighters]] when Borvo revealed his plan to turn [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo civilians]] in as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] for a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]].<ref name="BFN" />

Borvo was on board when the freighter was destroyed, but retreated to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] module. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Borvo's personal ship was a [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] called the ''[[Prosperous Secret]]''.<ref name="BFN" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Nabooart06.jpg|thumb|180px|Concept art of Borvo's Freighter]]

This freighter's type has only appeared is in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'', and has no official designation or class.<ref name="BFN" />
